propositions: prev_snapshot.json currently stores full ACLI payload at 228.1 MB / 4.5 MB per day; reducing to bare key-set {jira_key: {}} eliminates 27.1 MB overhead while retaining only 19,960 bytes of identifiers
Over 400 real revisions, 218 consecutive snapshot pairs have identical key sets and produce no commit; when key sets change, mean symmetric difference is 1.78 keys, reducing wasted raw mutations

Corpus mutation-diff on four real snapshot pairs with full prev versus key-set prev shows zero difference in observable mutation effects, because drop_snapshot_differ_local_state_emissions call-site filter prevents unbound_local and field_drift emissions regardless of prev shape
check_dual_identity_complete and differ local-only/emit-both arms require prev entries with {jira_key: {}} dict shape rather than sets, for local_state[key] or {} guards to function correctly

Backward compatibility: first pass after cutover tolerates old full-payload prev and writes key-set shape; committed corpus covers full-to-key-set and key-set-to-full transitions without unexpected inbound creates
